title: Director of Technical Accounting

title: Technical Risk Manager - Sr. Security Engineer I
description: For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day. Smartsheet needs a clear, defensible answer to "how risky is this?" for the risks that live inside our own environment and the risks that come in through every vendor and partner we rely on. We're looking for a Sr. Security Engineer I to own our Security Risk Management program end-to-end—running risk identification, analysis, and quantification; maintaining the enterprise risk register; and driving mitigation strategies that leadership can act on—while also overseeing our Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) function. You don't need to be a hands-on security engineer to succeed here: you need to understand our technology and architecture well enough to have a real conversation with engineering teams about their risk exposure, and you need the judgment and communication skill to turn technical risk into business language that drives decisions. This role sits at the center of how Smartsheet decides what to fix first, what to accept, and what a vendor relationship is actually costing us in risk. This role reports to the Senior Director, GRC Engineering and can be based in our Bellevue, WA office or remotely from anywhere in the US where Smartsheet is a registered employer. You Will: Own and mature Smartsheet's Security Risk Management program: risk identification, analysis, scoring, and quantification (e.g., FAIR-based or similar) across internal systems, third parties, and emerging initiatives. Maintain the enterprise risk register—ratings, ownership, mitigation status, and residual risk—and drive it toward a living, decision-useful tool rather than a static spreadsheet. Lead risk analysis and reviews for new initiatives, architecture changes, and significant findings, translating technical exposure into business-relevant risk statements for leadership. Develop and drive risk mitigation strategy: work with risk owners across engineering, IT, and business teams to define remediation plans, track them to closure, and escalate what isn't moving. Oversee Smartsheet's Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) program: vendor risk tiering, security assessment/questionnaire review, ongoing monitoring, and issue tracking for the vendor and partner ecosystem. Build and present risk reporting and KPIs/KRIs to security and business leadership, giving them a clear view of top enterprise risks and where mitigation investment should go. Partner with GRC, Field Security Engineering, and engineering leads to make sure risk findings from audits, pen tests, and questionnaires feed back into the same risk register and prioritization process. You Have: 4+ years of experience in security risk management, enterprise risk, or GRC, including direct ownership of a risk register and risk assessment process. Working familiarity with risk quantification approaches (FAIR, OCTAVE, or similar) and the judgment to apply them practically rather than academically. Enough technical fluency to understand cloud architecture, application security concepts, and common vulnerability/risk findings well enough to discuss them credibly with engineering teams—deep hands-on engineering experience is not required. Experience running or closely supporting a Third-Party Risk Management program: vendor tiering, questionnaire review, and ongoing monitoring. Excellent written and verbal communication skills; you can brief a risk finding to an engineering lead and to an executive and have both walk away with the right takeaway. Strong organizational skills and comfort managing many concurrent risk items and vendor relationships without losing track of status. Professional certifications: CRISC, CISSP, CISM, or equivalent. Experience with GRC or TPRM tooling (Vanta, Drata, OneTrust, Archer, ServiceNow GRC, or similar). Background supporting SOC 2, ISO 27001, or FedRAMP programs and an understanding of how risk management ties into those certifications. Experience presenting risk posture to senior leadership or board-level audiences. Legally eligible to work in the U.S. on an ongoing basis. Current US Perks & Benefits: Employer subsidized medical/vision and dental coverage for full-time employees 401k Match to help you save for your future (50% of your contribution up to the first 6% of your eligible pay) Monthly stipend to support your work and productivity Flexible Time Away Program, plus Sick Time Off US employees are automatically covered under Smartsheet-sponsored life insurance, short-term, and long-term disability plans US employees receive 12 paid holidays per year Up to 24 weeks of Parental Leave Personal paid V

title: Manager, Technical Accounting and Equity Reporting
description: Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles. Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office. As Oura scales and prepares for life as a public company, equity compensation and non-routine technical accounting questions are becoming larger and more complex. We’re looking for a Manager, Technical Accounting and Equity Reporting to own stock-based compensation accounting and equity reporting end to end, and to serve as a technical accounting resource on complex and non-recurring transactions.You’ll own ASC 718 accounting and the equity roll-forwards, reconciliations, footnotes, and disclosures that flow from it; work through the accounting for share repurchases; document accounting positions in clear memos; and build SOX-ready processes and controls. You’ll partner closely with Legal, Stock Administration, Payroll, Tax, Corporate Finance, FP&A, Business Systems, and our external auditors. What You Will Do: Stock-based compensation accounting (ASC 718) Own the monthly stock-based compensation close: validate grant, vesting, forfeiture, and termination data, calculate and record expense by function, and prepare the related journal entries. Review valuation inputs and assumptions (e.g., Black-Scholes, 409A) with valuation specialists and support the related audit evidence. Account for modifications, cancellations, repurchases, and settlement mechanics, including net share settlement. Reconcile the cap table and equity administration platform to the general ledger, and resolve differences promptly. Equity reporting and disclosures Prepare and review equity roll-forwards, APIC and stockholders’ equity activity, and stock-based compensation disclosures for quarterly and annual financial statements. Maintain audit-ready support and tie-outs for every equity figure in the financial statements and disclosures. Liquidity events and capital structure Lead the accounting analysis for tender offers, secondary transactions, IPO-related events, and corporate reorganizations as they affect employee equity. Lead the modeling process around the expected financial statement impact of an IPO on equity awards, including expense recognition, net settlement, and tax withholding, and keep the model current as timing and terms evolve. Technical accounting and policy Research complex accounting questions under US GAAP and write clear, well-supported technical memos that document facts, guidance, analysis, and conclusions. Serve as a technical resource on non-routine transactions beyond equity, as needed - areas could include: debt vs. equity accounting (ASC 480), debt (ASC 470), leases (ASC 842), business combinations (ASC 805), and global entity matters. Assist with drafting, updating, and maintaining accounting policies, and monitor new standards and SEC guidance for their impact on Oura. Controls and audit Design, document, and operate key controls over equity and technical accounting in partnership with the SOX team, and remediate gaps promptly. Serve as a primary contact for external auditors on equity and technical accounting, including walkthroughs, PBC requests, and technical discussions. What you'll bring 6+ years of progressive accounting and financial reporting experience, including Big 4 or national firm experience. Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance; active CPA strongly preferred. Hands-on expertise in ASC 718, including options, RSUs, performance-condition awards, modifications, repurchases and tender offers. Strong working knowledge of US GAAP and SEC reporting, with experience in ASC 718. Experience producing equity roll-forwards, footnotes, and disclosures for audited financial statements, and reconciling an equity administration platform (e.g., Carta, Shareworks) to the general ledger. Demonstrated ability to research complex technical matters independently and write defensible accounting memos. Experience designing and operating SOX or other internal controls over financial reporting. Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining complex topics to non-accounting partners, and a record of mentoring or managing others. Nice to have: Public company or IPO-readiness experience. Workiva and Shareworks experience. Experience in consumer hardware, health technology, or subscription businesses. Benefits At Ōura, we care about you and your well-being. Everyone here at Ōura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health. What we offer: Competitive salary and equity packages Health, dental, vision insurance, and mental health resources An Ōura Ring of your own plus employee discounts for friends & family 20 days of paid time off plus 13 paid holidays plus 8 days of flexible wellness time off Paid sick leave and parental leave Ōura takes a market-based approach to pay, which may vary depending on your location. US locations are categorized into tiers based on a cost of labor index for that geographic area. While most offers will be closer to the starting range, successful candidates' pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, internal peer equity, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future. Region 1 $143,650-$169,000 Region 2 $130,050-$153,000 Region 3 $117,300-$138,000 A recruiter can determine your Region based on your US location. We are not considering candidates residing in the following states: Alaska (AK), Delaware (DE), Iowa (IA), Mississippi (MS), Nebraska (NE), South Dakota (SD), West Virginia (WV), and Wisconsin (WI). ŌURA is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Individuals seeking employment at ŌURA are considered without regard to age, ancestry, color, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, protected family care or medical leave status, race, religion (including beliefs and practices or the absence thereof), sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. We will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Disclaimer: Beware of fake job offers! We’ve been alerted to scammers posing as ŌURA recruiters, especially for remote roles. Please note: Our jobs are listed only on the ŌURA Careers page and trusted job boards. We will never ask for personal information like ID or payment for equipment upfront. Official offers are sent through Docusign after a verbal offer, not via text or email. Stay cautious and protect your personal details. To all recruitment agencies: ŌURA does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, ŌURA employees, or any other organization's location. ŌURA is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

title: Director Cloud Architecture & Delivery
description: About Energy Exemplar In an era where the world is rapidly advancing towards a cleaner future through decarbonization, Energy Exemplar’s mission lies in ‘Empowering Transformative Energy Decisions’. Founded in 1999 in Adelaide, Australia, our award-winning software portfolio encompassing the modeling and simulation platform PLEXOS®, Aurora, and Adapt2, is trusted by innovative organizations across the globe. Through our technology and people, we strive to enable stakeholders from across the entire energy value chain to revolutionize the energy ecosystem and to collaboratively plan and execute for a sustainable energy future with unprecedented clarity, speed, and innovation. Our impact is global and is being recognized across the industry. Some of our recent accolades include: SaaS Company of the Year (2025) – Global Business Tech Awards. Environmental Impact Award (2025) – E+E Leaders Awards. IPPAI (Independent Power Producers Association of India) Power Awards (2025) - Winners Finalist: Platts Global Energy Awards (2024) – Grid Edge category Finalist: Reuters Global Energy Transition Awards (2024) – Technologies of Change Top 50 Marketing Team (2024) – Voted by the public at the ICON Awards. How We Work Energy Exemplar is growing fast and that growth is driven by how we work. We trust our team to deliver great results from wherever they work best, whether that’s at home, in the office, or on the move. We’re a global team that values ownership, integrity, and innovation. You’ll be supported to balance work and life in a way that works for you, and empowered to take initiative, solve problems, and make an impact, regardless of your background, location, or role. Our four core values, Customer Success, One Global Team, Integrity & Ownership, and Innovation Excellence aren’t just words. They show up in how we collaborate, how we solve, and how we grow together. About the Position The Director of Cloud Architecture & Delivery builds and leads the cloud architecture and forward-deployed engineering capability that enables Energy Exemplar's Solutions (pre-sales) organization to win and launch cloud-hosted and AI-enabled customers. This role builds and leads a team that works directly with customers to design, integrate, deploy, and validate cloud solutions and AI agents in customer environments. The position sits at the intersection of four disciplines: enterprise cloud architecture (Azure-first, multi-cloud fluent), energy-market software (PLEXOS, Aurora, Adapt2, and the PLEXOS Intelligence layer), applied AI and agentic systems, and consultative pre-sales. Utilities, ISOs/RTOs, developers, and regulators look to the Director for how Energy Exemplar's platform and AI agents run securely and at scale alongside their own cloud estates. The role owns the technical cloud and AI deployment in every pursuit: reference architectures, security and compliance responses, proof-of-concept environments, and the delivery plan that turns commitments made during the sales process into a practical, successful cloud and AI onboarding. The Director reports to the Vice President, Solutions (Americas) and sits within the Presales Solutions team. Partnering with Sales, Solutions, and Services, the Director shapes solutions for complex opportunities, leads technical conversations with senior customer stakeholders, and builds confidence in proposed architectures. The role works day to day with Sales and Account Directors, Solutions Engineers, Product and Engineering (PLEXOS Cloud and PLEXOS Intelligence), Post Sales Services, Customer Success, Information Security, and cloud platform partners to establish repeatable approaches to technical discovery, solution design, and validation, guide cloud migration and deployment planning, ensure a clear, practical handover into post-sales delivery, and build internal architectural expertise through coaching, enablement, and technical standards. It is a remote, United States-based Director-level position, a people-leader role that still expects individual-contributor depth, with travel of up to 30% for onsite customer meetings, executive briefings, and industry events across North America and LATAM. Key Responsibilities Build and lead a forward-deployed engineering capability that works closely with customer technical and business teams to translate priority use cases into deployed solutions. Embed with customer teams, on site and in their cloud tenants, to design, integrate, and deploy AI agents and agentic workflows built on PLEXOS Intelligence, including integration with customer data, enterprise systems, APIs, and Energy Exemplar products. Act as the senior cloud and AI technical advisor to customers and prospects (utilities, ISOs/RTOs, IPPs, and consultancies), engaging CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, enterprise architects, and IT leaders to build confidence and resolve technical objections. Partner with Sales and Pre Sales on technical deal strategy, architecture workshops, and demonstrations; scope and guide proofs of concept and pilots with clear success criteria, from environment build and data onboarding through executive readout. Define acceptance criteria with customers and validate deployed agents and solutions against the agreed success criteria (accuracy, performance, security, and human-in-the-loop controls), with evidence customers can take to their governance and risk teams. Own the cloud reference architectures for PLEXOS Cloud, PLEXOS Intelligence, and adjacent AI agents and products as deployed for customers: landing zones, identity and access, networking, data residency, high-performance compute for large nodal and stochastic runs, and cost models. Lead the pre-sales-to-Services handoff for cloud and AI deals: deployment plan, architecture decision record, risk register, and onboarding timeline agreed with Post Sales Services before contract signature. Develop migration roadmaps and delivery estimates with Services and Engineering, documenting assumptions, risks, and responsibilities before commitments are made, and provide architecture oversight for complex implementations so the proposed solution carries through to delivery. Set guardrails for agentic deployments in regulated environments: agent identity and permissions, tool-use boundaries, evaluation harnesses, observability, and audit trails. Lead cloud and AI architecture input into RFIs, RFPs, security reviews, vendor risk assessments, and proposals, coordinating specialist input and ensuring responses are accurate and achievable; lead customer discussions on SOC 2, ISO 27001, NERC CIP adjacency, FedRAMP-equivalent expectations, and CEII handling, and maintain a current response library with Information Security. Establish reusable discovery frameworks, technical materials, agent templates, and deployment patterns (SaaS, customer-tenant, hybrid), including integration with customer data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, Fabric, on-prem SQL) and API/automation patterns for model orchestration, plus runbooks and environment-as-code templates that make repeatable launches the default. Partner with Product Engineering to turn repeatable customer implementation patterns into supported product capabilities, reusable integrations, and deployment assets. Skills and Experience 12+ years in enterprise technology, including 7+ years designing and delivering production cloud architectures for enterprise or regulated customers in large or mid-sized organizations. Experience leading engineers embedded in customer implementations (forward-deployed, field engineering, or customer-embedded delivery teams), taking AI and data solutions from use case to production while managing customer expectations, scope, and handover. Strong customer-facing pre-sales experience supporting complex enterprise software opportunities, including technical discovery, solution validation and RFI or RFP responses. Deep expertise in at least one hyperscaler (Azure preferred) and working fluency across AWS and GCP: compute (VMs, Kubernetes, batch/HPC), storage, networking, identity (Entra ID, SSO/SAML/OIDC, SCIM), and managed data services. Experience designing AI agent engineering in production, including LLM application and agent orchestration frameworks, retrieval and tool integration, evaluation and monitoring, and model governance. Ability to connect architecture decisions to customer business objectives, commercial value and delivery feasibility, including cost and risk considerations. Strong understanding of enterprise integrations, REST/GraphQL, APIs and data flows, alongside cloud performance, scalability, governance and cost optimization. Executive presence, communication and the ability to lead architecture and risk conversations with CIOs, CISOs, enterprise architects, and procurement at utilities, ISOs/RTOs, and developers. A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer or Electrical Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field. Desirable Experience Master's degree in a technical or business discipline (MS, MEng, MBA) or equivalent demonstrated senior-level experience. Current professional-level cloud architecture certification: Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, or Google Professional Cloud Architect. Working knowledge of the North American power sector: ISO/RTO market structures (PJM, MISO, ERCOT, CAISO, SPP, NYISO, ISO-NE), utility IRP and transmission planning cycles, and the data-governance expectations that come with CEII and market-sensitive data. Direct experience with energy market simulation, production cost, capacity expansion, or resource adequacy tools (PLEXOS, Aurora, PROMOD, GridView, EnCompass, or similar), or with ETRM platforms such as Adapt2. Experience migrating on-premises, compute-intensive analytical software to cloud or SaaS delivery, including customer change management and license-model transitions. Experience building or scaling a pre-sales architecture capability and supporting cloud adoption across enterprise customers. Measures of Success Strong technical win rates and effective resolution of architecture and security objections in supported opportunities. Proofs of concept meet agreed success criteria and help customers make informed decisions. Proposed solutions are feasible, well documented and handed over clearly to delivery teams. Reusable architectures and enablement improve pre-sales efficiency and technical capability. Energy Exemplar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, identities, and abilities. Please let us know if you require accommodations at any stage of the recruitment process—we're here to support you in showcasing your full potential. Energy Exemplar respects your privacy and is committed to protecting the personal data you share during the recruitment process. This Candidate Privacy Notice explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you apply for a role with us.

title: Product Manager
description: About Figure Figure Technology Solutions, Inc. (Nasdaq: FIGR; OPEN: FGRS) is the leading blockchain-native capital marketplace for the origination, funding, sale and trading of tokenized assets. More than 480 partners use its loan origination system and capital marketplace. Collectively, Figure and its partners have originated over $30 billion of loans to date, among other products. The fastest growing components are Figure Connect, its credit marketplace, and Democratized Prime, Figure’s on-chain lend-borrow marketplace. Figure’s ecosystem also includes DART (Digital Asset Registry Technology) for asset custody and lien perfection, and $YLDS, a yield-bearing stablecoin registered with the SEC as a security under the Securities Act of 1933. Figure is the market leader in real-world asset (RWA) tokenization. The company has received triple-A ratings ratings from S&P and Moody’s on multiple loan securitizations, the first of its kind for blockchain finance. We’re proud to be recognized as one of Forbes’ Top 50 Fintech Companies and CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies . About the Role We’re looking for a Product Manager to join our growing team! As Product Manager, you’ll own the systems that keep our loans running after they close: servicing, payments and money movement, valuations, and the vendor integrations behind them. Our internal teams (Servicing, Treasury, Capital Markets, and Operations) are your customers, and the borrowers they serve feel every improvement you ship. You’ll own end-to-end execution across several products at once, work independently day to day, and partner with product leadership on the broader roadmap. What You’ll Do Own the back office: drive products that move real money and real loans, such as borrower payments, bank account verification, appraisals and inspections, and the data feeds our capital and servicing partners depend on Execute end-to-end: take projects from early conception through design, development, launch, and post-launch measurement Find where automation and AI can take manual work off our operations teams, and where a simpler software fix is the better answer Collaborate with a dedicated engineering team, driving requirements and engineering prioritization Manage multiple products in different phases of their lifecycle in parallel, from new integrations to keep-the-lights-on improvements Turn internal and borrower pain points into a prioritized roadmap, balance new initiatives with production support and operational improvements, and keep a live, refined backlog Partner with Treasury and engineering on bank and payment integrations (ACH, wires, account verification), and with vendors on appraisal, inspection, insurance, and servicing data feeds, with close attention to detail since a small mistake means a bounced payment or money movement issue Triage production support issues to tell real bugs from expected behavior, find the root cause, and turn recurring manual workarounds into product improvements Identify where AI meaningfully beats traditional software for our operations teams, and navigate edge cases, accuracy, and adoption Use data to size problems, model ROI, and define and track success metrics for your areas, including operational metrics such as automation rates, error rates, and time saved Lead Servicing, Treasury, Capital Markets, Compliance, and Operations stakeholders toward a shared roadmap, and communicate decisions and tradeoffs clearly What We Look For 2 to 4 years of relevant experience in product management or a related field, with multiple release cycles and product lifecycles completed as a PM Good understanding of lending, real estate, and industry dynamics, with experience in loan servicing, payments, or financial operations a strong plus Technical fluency: comfortable working closely with engineers on integrations, data models, and APIs, and able to read data well enough to answer your own questions Solid grasp of foundational AI concepts, and the judgment to know when (and when not) to apply them Strong strategic thinking, data analysis, and prioritization, with good judgment on tradeoffs, especially between new work and operational risk Excellent communication and stakeholder management, including with non-technical operations teams Ability to work fully independently on most day-to-day responsibilities, while taking guidance on high-level strategic roadmaps Experience with loan servicing systems, payment rails (ACH and wire), bank APIs, or vendor integrations (preferred) Experience working at a fast-growing startup, especially in FinTech or PropTech (preferred) Experience defining success metrics for automation, machine learning, or generative AI features (preferred) Experience vibe coding your own projects or for work (preferred) Adhere to all company security policies and data handling procedures. Complete mandatory security awareness training within required timeframes. Promptly report any suspected security incidents or suspi

title: Senior Product Manager
description: Who We Are CreateFuture is a Version 1 company and AI-native consulting partner  where people do work that matters and are supported to do it well. We work alongside organisations such as PayPal, adidas, NatWest, FanDuel and Money Saving Expert, building digital products and services that make a difference  while always putting people first. We’re a team of creators. We write code, shape delivery, build go-to-market strategies, develop AI solutions and create the practices that support our people. We work side by side with our clients, challenging what’s not working and helping them to build the future. Our commitment to craft, quality, and culture has helped us scale to over 600 people in just a few years. Our UK Benefits  35 days leave (including bank holidays).  Private medical insurance. Enhanced parental and adoption leave.  Financial coaching + 5% pension match. 40 hours of paid learning and development.  View our full list of UK benefits. CreateFuture is a  Great Place to Work-Certified™ company  and has won Best Workplaces UK multiple years in a row. Join us on our journey. Let’s create tomorrow, together, today. The Role CreateFuture are looking for a collaborative and pragmatic Lead Product Manager to join our growing team and help us define and develop an exciting array of products over a variety of industries, technologies and domains. Our Product Managers are responsible for working with senior leadership, our internal design and engineering teams and our clients to help define and implement product strategies that are consistent with our clients’ vision. This can be from early stage research and market analysis through to development, delivery and iteration. As we rapidly scale, we’ve identified an exciting opportunity for a Lead Product Manager to help support our growth.  This person will be responsible for shaping and leading client engagements. We have a variety of clients across many industries all of whom look to us to provide leadership and guidance.   You will rapidly gain their trust and guide them toward a valuable customer focused outcome. To do this you’ll use your deep understanding of product management methodologies and a consistent application of good practice.  You will also be responsible for the wellbeing of a team of product managers. You will help embed good practice and coach your team in client management techniques and the application of product management.  Does this sound like you? Do you have experience in developing Product Managers and a passion for the craft of Product Management? Do you have an empathetic leadership style with a focus on coaching each person to help grow their career and skills? If so, we’ve got a great role for you to stretch your wings and see what you’re really capable of. What you’ll be doing: Reporting into the Head of Product Operations and be able to represent the team as we grow Leading a team of Product Managers and support recruitment  Helping embed and support career progression pathways using our development framework for personal growth Providing support to the team through mentorship and coaching Acting as an escalation point for the team, helping to remove internal and external blockers as needed Supporting resourcing of Product Managers on projects Identifying training and development needs Lead clients through their digital transformation journey, ensuring long term lasting relationships are made with key decision-makers Working with the team to improve, shape and structure the Product Management ways of working About you Passionate about Product Management as a discipline and keen to keep up to date on emerging trends, as well as experimenting with new tools and techniques Recent relevant experience of leading product focused engagements  Knowledge and experience of Product Management frameworks and approaches for continuous discovery and delivery Have experience of product research and collecting evidence to support value propositions Experience working within a digital transformation and AI consultancy, delivering technology solutions to enterprise clients. Practical experience applying AI to products, services or delivery, with a good understanding of how AI can create value for clients. Experience mentoring, coaching and developing Product Managers and supporting the growth of product capability. Have experience of using data to help drive decisions and steer the direction of the product towards the client’s north star Knowledge of web and mobile technologies and practices Experience leading or supporting client discovery, workshops and product strategy, translating business needs into digital solutions. Be comfortable with ambiguity and help provide clarity in all situations    We’re particularly interested in people who are curious about how AI is changing the craft of Product Management and are actively exploring what that means in practice. Bonus points if you: Have experience shaping or delivering AI-enabled products, services or propositions, from early discovery through to live products. Understand the opportunities and limitations of LLMs, generative AI and agentic systems, and can translate these into meaningful customer and business outcomes. Have experimented with AI-native product development, using AI to accelerate research, discovery, prototyping, analysis, documentation or decision-making. Can identify where AI agents or automation could change a customer journey, business process or product experience, rather than simply adding AI features to an existing product. Understand some of the new product considerations AI introduces — including evaluation, trust, human oversight, data, governance and responsible AI. Are proactive about new AI capabilities, tools and ways of working, and enjoy helping others build their confidence and capability too. You don’t need to arrive as an AI expert.
